title: Checkboxes, Radio Buttons, and Switches
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of checkboxes, radio buttons, and switches and when it is appropriate.
Apply standard checkboxes using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check radio button groups and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study checkboxes, radio buttons, and switches and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Checkboxes, Radio Buttons, and Switches should guide users through a form rather than merely decorate controls. Associate labels and help text with fields, preserve native semantics, and validate submitted data on the server as well as in the browser.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating checkboxes, radio buttons, and switches as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.
